description: This file defines API endpoints for managing notes in a notes application, including creating, listing, searching, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and defines multiple route handlers with associated metadata.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Model class representing a note in the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class representing a user in the database.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new note.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing note.

methods.name: NoteRead create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))

methods.description: Searches notes by text query across title, content, and tags.
